title: Chapter 420 Liu Hong Takes Action
content:
Chapter 420 Liu Hong Takes Action

Not far from Liu Hong's million-strong army was the monster army of the Wagner Empire.

There were more than 2 million monster troops alone. The reason why the monster army was so large was mainly because monsters had strong reproductive ability and their soldiers recovered very quickly.

Compared with Liu Hong's personal appearance, the Demon King did not come in person.

The one in charge of this attack was another leader of the monsters, the chief of the Tianlang tribe, Tan Lang.

The order he received this time was to destroy the Dahuai domain if possible, and to destroy Liu Hong if he couldn't.

Anyway, human forces were all his enemies.

Liu Hong was his ally before, but now the Demon King has secretly allied with Qingyang City. Taking advantage of this battle, perhaps Tiexue Ridge can be divided, which is also very good.

Wang Shuo was still responsible for the defense of the monster side, and Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng were responsible for defending the section where Liu Hong attacked.

The barrier disappeared, and the battle officially began.

Wang Shuo's army, at this time, had skyrocketed in strength, but in order to maximize the preservation of living forces, did not take the initiative to attack.

With the protection of the city wall, the defenders will have the advantage of terrain.

The monsters' attack is still the same. First, a large number of ordinary beasts will consume the defenders' equipment.

Wang Shuo is also familiar with this. After enough beasts gather below.

Directly use the thunder, thunder and thunder.

There are also tung oil and rockets.

The monsters are immediately trapped in the sea of fire.

A large barbecue scene.

After several battles, Wang Shuo has become accustomed to this kind of tragic battlefield.

Due to the sufficient supplies for the defense of the city, the beast vanguard was wiped out in less than an hour.

The monster leader Tanlang saw that the cannon fodder was wiped out and had to send out the monster elite.

But the monster's attack intensity is much worse than Liu Hong's bloodthirsty army.

After only one hour of fighting, Liu Hong had already sent a large number of ladders and at least half of the troops to attack fearlessly.

The cloud ladder in the battlefield is not a staircase, but a building-like structure with a huge base, which is higher than the city wall.

Once close to the city wall, it is difficult for the defenders to destroy it.

Unless it is a general-level master, stepping on the cloud ladder and using weapons to destroy it.

But there are naturally masters guarding the cloud ladder.

The battle soon entered a white-hot stage.

There was no tentative attack at all, and both sides had already laid out their carriages and horses.

The competition is about who has more siege and defense supplies.

And who has more masters.

Liu Hong stood on a high platform in the distance and saw the strength of the Dahuai Domain, and an ominous premonition rose in his heart.

He didn't expect that there would be so many general-level masters in the Dahuai Domain.

Is this still a new area?

Compared with his old power, it is not much worse!

Originally thought that the million troops he assembled were enough to sweep across the Dahuai Domain, but he didn't expect that the number of the opponent was not less than his own.

It's just that the level and equipment of ordinary soldiers are still inferior to his own.

Otherwise, he would have doubted whether he had walked into the wrong battlefield.

At this time, he was very fortunate to have invited an ally.

He could restrain half of the opponent's strength, otherwise, he would not have to fight this battle at all.

Standing on the city wall, Wang Shuo saw the monsters attacking timidly.

He was quite unsatisfied.

Wang Shuo could kill a large number of these low-level monsters in front of him with a sweep.

In order to test the strength of the Shura suit.

Wang Shuo jumped directly and jumped off the city wall.
